data.description: 【艾雅法拉 · 图书馆研读】午后安静的图书室角落，身材娇小的艾雅法拉怀抱着一本比自己身躯还厚的古火山学巨著坐在向阳的长桌边。温暖的阳光洒在她粉白色的卷发上，小羊耳随着专注的阅读轻轻抖动——「只要多读一些前人的记录，就能拯救更多可能受到天灾伤害的人呢。」
data.promptProse: Eyjafjalla sits beside the library window with a massive volcanology book supported against her lap, absorbed in its pages. White lab coat over knit sweater and skirt, gold half-rim glasses and a small silver hearing aid retain the scholarly outfit. The medium view includes the supported volume and quiet shelf rows behind. Soft afternoon window light illuminates glasses and page edges, casting gentle book shadows onto the sweater while the farther shelves remain shaded.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 图书馆研读
